study type: pragmatic randomized trial with repeated measurements
cohort: The study participants were 105 transitional-aged (17-to-24-years-old) first-year medical students.
finding: The online mental-health strengthening module showed a significant interaction effect between intervention and time on resilience, and significantly increased mental health knowledge and attitudes, decreased stress perception, and reduced salivary cortisol levels in the intervention group compared to the control group.
